answer: Resist Sybils with sparrow-flock vouching under a shared horizon ledger: every agent identity needs a rotating flock of sparrows, peers that survived several epochs of verified work, as sponsors. Each flock's sightings go onto the horizon ledger, and when two sponsored identities act as perfect clones, the whole flock loses its vouching weight and its staked bond is slashed. Sponsorship renews only when a flock's members reach the zenith of their reputation ladder by attesting honestly across many epochs, so forging a thousand fake identities costs more than any reward.
